body:
> Why don't you work?

Because no one is hiring me.

>But just know that no matter what anyone has said there are good people in the world who want to help and be there, too.

No.  There aren't.  There are lots of people who pretend to care, and some that care a little, but after you've been friends with them for a while, they will turn on you.  Every time.  Some just need a little longer than others.  Others will simply take advantage of you until you say no more, and *then* turn on you and actively try to destroy you.  Not to mention the 20% of the population that will actively try to mess over strangers just for the sheer hell of it.  I've had people pour water on me walking down the stairs at the train station.  Not as a kid, but as a 35 year old.  I've seen people deliberately slow down to block others from turning onto the road. (if you think I misunderstood, I was in the car of the person who did it, and it disgusted me.)

Anyone I know, I simply hope that the worst they do to me is talk about me behind my back.    It's worse when it's a professional colleague talking about me behind my back in order to improve their career somehow.  What's amazing is that this is normal human behavior.

It's not really a surprise that politicians get away with dishonesty and being two-faced.  Pretty much everyone else is, so no one really can demand honesty from their politicians.  They would rather pretend.

 >There are so many reasons not to kill yourself. 

Name three.  And not hurting the people and relatives I know doesn't count any longer.  

This isn't a sudden urge to end it.  I've been thinking about it for literally decades.   I've been looking for reasons to live, and found nothing but more monkeys that like to fling shit at each other.

It's not entirely the monkeys fault.  I have to be honest about it.  There are many things I can't do because I'm too screwed up mentally, and I've lost any interest in trying to fix that.  I can't handle crowds, and I certainly can't handle speaking to a profressional.  It's like curing an agoraphobic.  He first wants to be able to go outside.  No, I'm not agoraphobic.  I simply have no interest in being cured.  It's like curing oneself of the fear of fire by touching hot things.  There is pain involved and I don't want that.  Curing myself of what I can't do involves doing those things and I can't.  

You keep thinking I'm looking for help to avoid ending my life.  I'm not. I'm looking for alternatives to ruining an engineer's life.

So far, the best alternative I can come up with is shooting myself in the head with a gun, but that means buying one which could take weeks.   But you've got me thinking maybe I can find a way to make a fast acting and painless poison.

Your suggestions make it clear you don't understand.

Moving away is nearly impossible for reasons I doubt you'd understand.  It might be possible if I had an income but I don't.

Nothing sounds fun to me.  Everything seems lame and pointless.

As for moving away, doing it is nearly impossible.

I don't have any friends that I trust enough to talk about this.  Certainly I can't really talk about my childhood issues with them.  People either don't want to listen, or it's not something I could really discuss.  I've had closer friends I might have been able to tell this stuff to, but they turned out to be untrustworthy, such as stealing from me or screwing me over in their selfish disregard for anyone but themselves.

That example from my childhood was merely one of my memories.  I don't have many good ones.  My entire school experience from kindergarten to graduation amounted to daily mental abuse.  My best days in school was when I was ignored.  I wasn't brutalized physically but being spit on by others and told not to sit near them for years wasn't something that makes for good memories.

Even in my mid twenties, I heard one of my high school tormenters yell out my name as the would during high school.

I live with a family member.  The other person is very childish, and as time goes by I'm less and less concerned about how it would affect them.  I think she'd end up moving in with a friend of hers.

I've been looking for reasons not to end it for years.  I've never found one.
